description: Which score of each reward model is evaluated on which AURA-Test metric. Columns follow the table order Aesthetic; Realism; Fidelity; BC; FC; SC. null = the model has no dimension for that metric, reported as '-'. Each column is evaluated only on the AURA-Test rows whose 'metric' field equals the column's bench_metric. Decided by the user on 2026-11-11.

EditReward.Visual Quality: rm_heads.head_1 with the dim2 prompt INSTRUCTION_EDIT_QUALITY
EditReward.Instruction Following: rm_heads.head_0 with the dim1 prompt INSTRUCTION_EDIT_FOLLOWING

EditScore.Semantic Consistency: SC prompt, score = min(editing success, overediting) as in editscore/__init__.py
EditScore.Perceptual Quality: PQ prompt on the edited image only, score = min(naturalness, artifacts)

SpatialReward.Semantic Consistency: SC prompt, score = min(editing success, overediting), same rule as EditScore
SpatialReward.Perceptual Quality: PQ prompt on the edited image only, score = min(naturalness, artifacts)

models.not_run: user decision 2026-11-11: 72B is not downloaded or evaluated

models.checkpoint: student_pipeline_overall_finegrained_gemmaGT_1008_r64_lr4e-5_batch16_head_fp32_initialized_from_inspector_checkpoint63/student_warmstart.pt (= checkpoint-126, 1008 pairs); represents Stage 1: Teacher-Stage1 is a copy of it, same scores

model_input: Every bench row is given to every model with the source image, the edited image and the instruction, for all six metrics. Each reward model then builds its own native prompt from them (for example the EditScore / SpatialReward Perceptual Quality prompt itself shows only the edited image); the native protocol is not changed.

evaluation_metrics.pair_margin: margin = score(edited_images[0]) - score(edited_images[1]) on the dimension chosen for the column; computed only on bench rows of that column's metric

main_table.Accuracy: non-tie pairs: share with sign(margin) equal to the human label (A -> +, B -> -); margin == 0 counts as wrong
main_table.Margin AUC: non-tie pairs: symmetric within-pair margin AUC (each pair contributes +margin with label A-better and -margin with the opposite orientation), as in RewardModelEvaluation
main_table.Three-class Accuracy: all pairs, ties included: predicted A / B / Tie equals the human label. Student-Stage1 / Student-Stage2 / Teacher-Stage2: argmax of P(A), P(B), P(Tie) from the Tie Head. Score-only models: native behaviour, Tie only when score_A == score_B exactly; no threshold is tuned on the bench (user decision 2026-11-11, option 2). Reported with per-class recall and precision.

secondary_table.PLCC: all pairs of the metric (ties included): Pearson correlation between margin and human vote margin (votes A - votes B) / number of raters
secondary_table.SRCC: same pairs and targets as PLCC, Spearman rank correlation
secondary_table.Tie AUC: all pairs of the metric: AUC of -|margin| for separating Tie-labelled pairs from non-tie pairs
secondary_table.Tie Head AUC: all pairs: AUC of P(Tie) from the Tie Head separating tie pairs from the rest; only Student-Stage1 / Student-Stage2 / Teacher-Stage2 (models with a Tie Head), '-' for the others; reported next to Tie AUC from -|margin|, which every model has (user decision 2026-11-13)

uncertainty.confidence_interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over pairs for every cell, 2000 resamples, fixed seed
uncertainty.paired_comparison: paired bootstrap (same resampled pairs) of the difference Student-Stage2 (row with paired_reference) minus each other model, per cell
